judge_claim: The D-RUT protocol learns all coefficients of a generic multi-mode finite-order bosonic Hamiltonian with total evolution time O(1/epsilon).

domain.hamiltonian_terms: all Hermitian single-mode monomials through degree 2 plus both independent quadratic two-mode couplings
domain.estimator: physical displacement, independent local number twirl, sampled X/Y robust phase estimation, Chebyshev/IDFT single-mode recovery, hierarchical coupling residual recovery

exact_statement_tested: For a fixed finite number of modes and maximum degree, D-RUT recovers every independent coefficient and its fixed design preserves the RPE O(1/epsilon) total-evolution scaling.
non_circularity: All seven RPE horizons are run and their first-hit behavior is observed. No error values or slopes are injected. The SQL comparison samples the same physical ancilla X/Y probabilities at kappa=1 under exactly the same evolution-time budget.
negative_controls: same-budget conventional kappa=1 Ramsey sampling should scale as T^-1/2
omitting displacement must leave non-number-conserving coefficients unrecovered
omitting the local number twirl must leave the vacuum coupled off diagonal
verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if the exact fixed-design resource certificate, all physical checks, coefficient recovery, slopes, independent checker, and all controls pass; otherwise BLOCKED.
